communications.subject: EuroLux Boutique — Order Confirmation #ELB-3392
communications.body: Merci for your purchase! Your Italian Leather Crossbody Bag (Tan) is confirmed. Total: €215.00. We will ship to your address within 3-5 business days.

communications.subject: Wrong currency charged
communications.body: Your website showed $220.00 USD at checkout but I was charged in EUR which ended up costing me $247.50 after conversion. I agreed to $220 USD, not €215. Please refund the difference.

communications.subject: RE: Wrong currency charged
communications.body: We apologize for the confusion. Our payment processor handles all transactions in EUR as we are based in France. The USD amount shown on our website is an estimate. We can offer a €10 store credit for the inconvenience but cannot refund the conversion difference.
